name: Cyclotella meneghiniana
author: Kützing, 1844
description: A cosmopolitan centric diatom common in eutrophic lakes and slow-moving rivers. Valve diameter 6–40 µm.

name: Navicula cryptocephala
author: Kützing, 1844
description: A pennate diatom with lanceolate to rhombic-lanceolate valves. Widely distributed in clean to moderately polluted waters.

name: Aulacoseira granulata
author: (Ehrenberg) Simonsen, 1979
description: Chain-forming centric diatom typical of turbid, eutrophic lakes. Cylindrical cells with coarse striae.
